name: 엘레나
visual_review: 푸른 트윈테일과 차가운 눈매를 유지했습니다. 무릎 굽힘·활주·회전·레이피어 지목·얼음 솟기·회수까지 구분됩니다. 빙결 효과 외곽은 셀 경계와 가까워 프레임 재생 여백이 필요합니다.
motion_summary: Elena, icy blue twin-tail hair, skating dress and slender rapier exactly from portrait. Official R creates a circular ice zone with suddenly rising ice in its central area. Animate elegant skating idle; bent knee wind-up; gliding short arc; opening arms and rapier sideways; half-turn spin; upright dancer pose; pointing rapier toward right; circular pale cyan frost spreading outward; central jagged ice crystals erupt right of her; finishing spin; shallow skate stop; original idle. Real leg/skate and arm changes, no huge opaque ice in front of face. Ice blue white with restrained indigo shadows.
